scripts.title: Auto Play Checkpoint & Prestige
scripts.features:
A headless auto checkpoint and prestige with a 99.9% success rate with auto recovery. Anti-AFK included.
1 Prestige every 8 minutes and 58.59 seconds.
1 Checkpoint every 0.65 seconds.





Measured at 240 fps with volcano executor.
scripts.script:
local Checkpoints = workspace.Checkpoints
local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart
local Humanoid = Character.Humanoid
local StageValue = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function UpdateVars()
	repeat task.wait()
		Character = LocalPlayer.Character
		RootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	until RootPart and Humanoid
end

--remove kill parts
local LavaFloors = workspace:FindFirstChild("LavaFloors")
if LavaFloors then
	LavaFloors:Destroy()
end

local function GetStage()
	return StageValue.Value
end
local function Touch(Part)
	UpdateVars()
	RootPart.CFrame = Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart,Part,0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart,Part,1)
end

-- Anti-AFK
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
    VirtualUser:CaptureController()
    VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
end)

while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = GetStage()
	local NextStage = CurrentStage + 1
	local CheckName = tostring(NextStage)
	local Checkpoint = nil
	Checkpoint = Checkpoints:FindFirstChild(CheckName)
	if Checkpoint then
		Touch(Checkpoint)
	else
		game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.prestige:FireServer()
		Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
	end
end

    if not player then

    end

    if not player.Character then
        player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    end
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local finishPart = nil

    local searchLocations = {
        Workspace.Terrain and Workspace.Terrain.Obbyplot and Workspace.Terrain.Obbyplot["write your obby name"] and Workspace.Terrain.Obbyplot["write your obby name"].finish_normal,
        Workspace

        if location then
            local found = location:FindFirstChild("money")
            if found and found:IsA("Part") then
                finishPart = found
                break
            end
            found = location:FindFirstChild("money", true)
            if found and found:IsA("Part") then
                finishPart = found
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if finishPart then

            finishPart.Anchored = false

            end

August 10th, 2026: Hey guys! This script will no longer be in support. The reason is due to the game shutting down on August 9th. It was such a huge blast making this script, however, all good things must eventually come to an end. If you've used this script and are reading this, thank you 🫡


Small low quality script that adds extra features, a bunch can be found in the Settings, the gear icon underneath.
● Teleport To Lobby (Teleports you back to the Lobby where you first spawn in)
● Morph Button + Name Textbox
● Faceless (MUST BE ENGEL, CLAIRE, LANA, OR BUBBLE)
● Give Paper/Book (MUST BE STUDENT)
● OG CS Music (Replaces the Character Selection music with the one from when the game first launched)
● Swap CS/SOC/TMale/TFem/Silly (Replaces either the Character Selection, Student OC, Male Teacher OC, Female Teacher OC, or Silly OC's musics with whatever SoundID you input
● OG CS Screen Replica (Replictes how the Character Selection Screen looked when the game first launched, WIP) 
● Restore CS Music (Reverts the Character Selection music back to the original)

v1.3 -- ● Removed Circle and Bubble Anims Buttons, integrating them into the Morph button. ● Changed the Custom Animation Buttons on Circle and Bubble to be styled similar to how the normal buttons are. ● Changed all of the custom buttons' Font in the settings to match that of the Font the pre-existing options have. ● Moved Restore Character Selection Screen Music to the right of the Settings.
